programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programmes.d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programmes.d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programmes.d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programmes.d: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programmes.d: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programmes.d: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
programmes.d: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

programmes.t: Sinister
programmes.d: Ellison er kriminalforfatter, og i jagten på den gode historie flytter han hele familien til et nyt hus, som gemmer på en grusom hemmelighed. I huset finder Ellison nogle gamle smalfilm og står nu med kilden til det, der kan blive hans bedste bog.

programmes.t: Night of the Living Dead
programmes.d: Mysterious radiation from space suddenly causes the dead to rise and seek human flesh. The zombies converge on a small group of people who must band together in a house and survive until help arrives.

programmes.t: Body Count
programmes.d: From Italian horror maestro Ruggero Deodato, this brutal slasher film follows a group of college students as they are stalked by a terrifying figure in the Colorado wilderness.

programmes.t: Body Parts
programmes.d: Da Bill Chrashank mister sin arm i en bilulykke, får han indopereret armen fra en henrettet forbryder. Det eneste problem, som Bill snart opdager, er, at armen er besat af en kraft, som han ikke kan kontrollere.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programmes.d: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programmes.d: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programmes.d: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programmes.d: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programmes.d: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programmes.d: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
programmes.d: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programmes.d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
